notes.title: Armorgeddon Release Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262122/0f36f74bd2cdb86e9630f2d5490dc87c04034521.jpg
December 16th - Prepare to survive Armorgeddon.  Easy to pickup, challenging to play!.  24 levels of turn based strategy,  Will you use power ups to turn the tide of battle, will you pool your victory coins into a pile to buy faction abilities or can you win with just your units?  What combinations of strategies will you come up with to win the day?  
Make your units your own by painting your units in one of five camo patterns.
